instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet, white walls, and a ceiling-mounted projector. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing slightly right with a neutral expression. On the right, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, reaching his right hand to touch her left shoulder. The scene is illuminated by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
